text:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH latency + elevated 5xx on model-family=marlin9b in us-west-2 (p95 latency 2.1s -> 4.8s, error-rate 3.2%). Paging @jamie (sre oncall) and @rachel (runtime).
jamie: seeing it. I’m pulling traces now. can someone confirm whether this is internal queuing or model compute saturation? cc @tom
rachel: traces show sustained batch queue growth on marlin9b workers, KV cache miss rate spiked ~5x. looks compute-backed, not network.
jamie: thanks. tentative mitigation plan: 1) reduce per-model TPM/RPM for marlin9b 2) disable function-calling for marlin9b 3) enable fallback routing to marlin9b-lite. need agreement from platform + support for customer-impact callouts.
tom: agree. I can push a routing rule in the gating layer. will prepare a per-tenant carveout for customers with SLA (so we don't break AcmeHealth / BetaCorp).
leena: FYI support: AcmeHealth is seeing higher error rates but still within their sentinel alerting; they want updates once we change quotas. please add them to the incident update.
carlos: product: disabling funcall will affect a handful of customers using tool integration. recommend blocking only for marlin9b heavy-tier traffic, keep lite for funcall if possible.
jamie: ok we’ll do a soft RPM/TM cut first. proposing: reduce TPM from 2400 -> 1200 and RPM from 100 -> 40 for marlin9b family. funcall: toggle OFF for marlin9b compute tier only.
rachel: commands ready. admin API calls:

```
# reduce tpm/rpm for model family
POST https://admin.internal/api/v1/quotas/models/marlin9b
{ "tpm": 1200, "rpm": 40, "note": "emergency latency mitigation 4312345678" }

# disable funcall for runtime profile
POST https://admin.internal/api/v1/features/models/marlin9b
{ "funcall_enabled": false }
```

deploy-bot: applied quota change to marlin9b: tpm=1200 rpm=40. funcall toggle queued on 3 nodes. (job-id: deploy-431234)
jamie: verifying traffic shaping now. can everyone watch the dashboard (per-model latency + error-rate)?
sydney: watching. p95 dropping to ~2.6s within 40s of the quota change. errors trending down.
leena: sent customer note to AcmeHealth and BetaCorp citing limited impacts and mitigation steps. they acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
carlos: product request: schedule a follow-up to re-enable funcall on marlin9b-lite within 2 hours if stable, and plan a canary roll for marlin9b full later.
jamie: agree. next steps: leave quotas in place for 30m, monitor, then slowly raise if stable. if error-rate < 0.5% and p95 < 2s for 10m, increment TPM by +300.
ray: (reacting) NOTE: ray is not in thread (ignore) 

rachel: note for postmortem: KV cache pressure + recent kernel change on marlin9b workers may have reduced effective throughput. include profiling snapshots.
jamie: creating incident doc. tagging severity: SEV3 -> SEV2 during peak, now steadying. assigning postmortem to @rachel and @carlos. Thanks everyone — keep monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident updated: marlin9b latency spike. status=mitigated, active_mitigation=per-model quota reduction + funcall disable, followup=postmortem assigned. link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/4312345678
